newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-STIMAC OUT FOR FIVE WEEKS FOLLOWING HERNIA OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STIMAC OUT FOR FIVE WEEKS FOLLOWING HERNIA OPERATION.

text.p: English premier league side Derby will be without captain Igor Stimac for up to five weeks after the Croatian defender underwent a hernia operation on Thursday.
The 1.5 million pounds ($2.4 million) signing from Hajduk Split had been troubled by the problem for several months and with a two-match ban looming Derby decided to book him in for surgery.
Manager Jim Smith said: "It's disappointing for us but we have been aware of the problem for a while."
